name: Mewar Hi-Tech Engineering Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2006, Mewar Hitech Engineering Ltd manufactures construction equipment[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MHEL is an ISO 9001:2008 certified manufacturer of crushing screening and size reduction equipment. It has a manufacturing facility is in Sukher, Udaipur. Company sells its product under its brand, Kingson.

cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
